description: Defines the UtilsVk class, a helper for Vulkan rendering utilities such as buffer/image clear, copy, conversion, blit/resolve, overlay drawing, and related internal structures and methods.

classes.name: UtilsVk
classes.description: A helper class providing Vulkan rendering utilities such as buffer/image operations, blit/resolve, overlay drawing, and internal resource management.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Releases Vulkan resources associated with the UtilsVk instance.

methods.name: clearBuffer
methods.description: Clears a buffer with specified parameters.

methods.name: convertIndexBuffer
methods.description: Converts an index buffer from one format to another.

methods.name: convertLineLoopIndexIndirectBuffer
methods.description: Converts a line loop index indirect buffer.

methods.name: convertLineLoopArrayIndirectBuffer
methods.description: Converts a line loop array indirect buffer.

methods.name: convertVertexBuffer
methods.description: Converts a vertex buffer between formats.

methods.name: clearFramebuffer
methods.description: Clears a framebuffer with specified parameters.

methods.name: colorBlitResolve
methods.description: Performs color blit or resolve on images.

methods.name: stencilBlitResolveNoShaderExport
methods.description: Performs stencil blit/resolve without shader export.

methods.name: copyImage
methods.description: Copies image data between Vulkan images.

methods.name: setupProgram
methods.description: Sets up Vulkan pipeline and binds shaders for a specified rendering function.

methods.name: ensureResourcesInitialized
methods.description: Initializes descriptor sets, layouts, and pools for a specific function.

methods.name: allocateDescriptorSet
methods.description: Allocates a Vulkan descriptor set for a specific function.
